title: Positions at the table
summary: The names of the seats at 6-max and 9-max tables.

intro.text: Positions are counted from the button, not from the player: after every hand all positions move one seat. The names below are what players use worldwide.

six.caption: 6-max: UTG (under the gun), HJ (hijack), CO (cutoff), BTN (button), SB and BB (the blinds).

nine.caption: 9-max: UTG+1, MP (middle position) and LJ (lojack) come before the hijack.

groups.text:
Positions fall into groups:
- **Early**: UTG, UTG+1, with many players still to act behind you.
- **Middle**: MP, LJ, HJ.
- **Late**: CO and BTN, with only the blinds behind you.
- **The blinds**: SB and BB, who have chips in already but act first after the flop.

hu.caption: Heads-up: the button is also the small blind. It acts first before the flop and last after it.

q-last.q: Who acts last after the flop if everyone is still in?
q-last.explain: After the flop the first player left of the button starts and the button acts last. That's why it is the best seat at the table.

t1.q: At 6-max, which seat is directly to the right of the button?
t1.explain: The 6-max order is UTG, HJ, CO, BTN, SB, BB. The cutoff sits right before the button.

t2.explain: UTG acts first preflop with the most players behind: an early position.

t3.q: Heads-up, who acts first before the flop?
options: The button, who is also the small blind
t3.explain: Heads-up, the button posts the small blind and acts first before the flop, then last after it.
